_source: Extracted here (token-free) from KPR's own lease-abstract workbook 'Cooks Corner - UPDATED 06.07.2024.xls' (Issues Summary + per-tenant tabs). These are KPR's executed-lease abstracts with section citations. 15 current tenants; former tenants (Sears, Regal Cinema, Big Lots, Bank of Maine) excluded as vacated. Hobby Lobby, Camden National Bank and The Hearth Doctor have no tab (newer leases).

exclusives.description: Landlord (or any Affiliate) will not directly or indirectly lease, use or permit any portion of the Shopping Center — or land within 1 mile owned/controlled by Landlord — for a supermarket / grocery use.

goDarkRight.summary: If Tenant fails to open the required 1 day, or after opening closes for 180 consecutive days, Landlord may terminate on written notice.

leaseNotes.label: Exclusive Use
leaseNotes.value: Grocery/supermarket exclusive across the center and within 1 mile (LL-owned/controlled).

leaseNotes.label: Go Dark Option
leaseNotes.value: LL may terminate if Tenant closes 180 consecutive days.

leaseAbstracts.narrative: Hannaford (grocery anchor, ~47,429 SF; Delhaize America / Ahold Delhaize guaranty for the full term). 1-mile grocery exclusive; landlord may terminate on a 180-day go-dark. 6 × 5-year renewal options.

exclusives.description: No other premises in the Shopping Center may contain more than 15,000 SF devoted to the sale or display of apparel-type merchandise.

triggerLogic.scope: retail space in the Shopping Center
triggerLogic.note: If for more than 150 consecutive days, 150,000 SF of retail space in the Shopping Center is not open/operating.

remedy.note: Co-tenancy relief per §4.7 / 2nd Amendment — confirm remedy.

goDarkRight.summary: If the Premises closes 60 consecutive days or more, Landlord may terminate.

earlyTerminationOption.summary: Tenant may terminate if zoning will not permit the retail sale of wearing apparel.

leaseNotes.label: Exclusive Use
leaseNotes.value: No other space >15,000 SF of apparel.

leaseNotes.label: Co-tenancy
leaseNotes.value: If 150,000 SF of center retail is dark >150 consecutive days.

leaseNotes.label: Go Dark Option
leaseNotes.value: LL may terminate on a 60-day closure.

leaseAbstracts.narrative: TJ Maxx (TJX, 30,000 SF, expiry 1/31/2033, 3×5-yr options). Apparel exclusive (no other >15,000 SF apparel); an occupancy co-tenancy (150,000 SF of center retail dark >150 days); zoning termination right; landlord 60-day go-dark recapture.

sourceDocuments.name: KPR lease-abstract workbook — TJ Maxx tab

documents.name: Second Amendment
documents.description: Relocation of premises; 10-yr term from New Premises CD; 4 × 5-yr options.

exclusives.description: No part of the Center, nor any property within 1 mile owned by Landlord or an affiliate, may be used for office-supply / business-products services then provided by Tenant (carve-out for existing tenants).

triggerLogic.note: Initial Co-Tenancy: a 48,000 SF grocer (or comparable user in ≥75% of that space) must be open in the area on Ex. A.1.
Ongoing Co-Tenancy: if for 90 consecutive days TJ Maxx (30,000 SF) [and/or other named requirement] is not open.

leaseNotes.label: Co-tenancy
leaseNotes.value: Initial: 48,000 SF grocer open. Ongoing: TJ Maxx (30,000 SF) open (90-day test).

leaseAbstracts.narrative: Staples (15,664 SF, expiry 6/30/2030, 4×5-yr options to $18 PSF). 1-mile office-supply exclusive; a two-part co-tenancy — an opening test on a 48,000 SF grocer (Hannaford) and an ongoing test on TJ Maxx. 2025 sales $187 PSF / 8.2% occ cost.

exclusives.description: Dollar-store / single-price-point exclusive (while operating, no default beyond cure). Carve-outs incl. outparcel occupants. If violated and uncured 30 days, minimum rent reduces; clause can become null/void on uncured violation.

triggerLogic.note: If TJ Maxx (its successors/assigns/replacements) ceases to operate.

goDarkRight.summary: If Tenant ceases operating, Landlord may terminate on 30 days' notice.

leaseNotes.label: Go Dark Option
leaseNotes.value: LL may terminate on Tenant cease (30-day notice).

leaseNotes.label: Relocation
leaseNotes.value: LL may relocate Tenant (at LL expense) to comparable premises in the designated relocation areas, 90 days' notice.

leaseAbstracts.narrative: Dollar Tree (12,000 SF, expiry 10/31/2030, 3×5-yr options). Dollar-store exclusive; a co-tenancy keyed to TJ Maxx staying open; landlord go-dark recapture and a landlord relocation right.

sourceDocuments.name: KPR lease-abstract workbook — Dollar Tree tab

exclusives.description: So long as Tenant is in possession, no other space in the Shopping Center may sell auto parts, batteries, accessories, oils or lubricants (carve-outs apply).

leaseNotes.label: Exclusive Use
leaseNotes.value: Auto parts / batteries / accessories / oils & lubricants exclusive.

leaseAbstracts.narrative: Advance Auto Parts (Advance Stores Company, 8,000 SF, expiry 12/31/2034, 2×5-yr options). Auto-parts exclusive; 100% holdover. No co-tenancy/go-dark/guaranty.

sourceDocuments.name: KPR lease-abstract workbook — Advance Auto tab

leaseNotes.label: Guaranty

leaseAbstracts.narrative: Applebee's (5,636 SF, expiry 8/31/2032 incl. options, 2×5-yr). Restaurant exclusive (first 10 years); guaranty has expired; go-dark silent.

goDarkRight.summary: If Subtenant ceases business (other than Excused Periods) for 6+ consecutive months, Sublandlord may recapture/terminate.

flags.detail: Burger King occupies under a SUBLEASE (Sublandlord) — likely a ground/pad structure (0 building SF in owned GLA; $82,500/yr ground rent). Confirm the prime lease / ground lease and recapture mechanics.

leaseAbstracts.narrative: Burger King (pad, ~3/31/2037, 3×5-yr options). Held under a SUBLEASE; sublandlord recapture on a 6-month go-dark. No percentage rent.

goDarkRight.summary: If Tenant vacates >120 days (other than a Permitted Closure), Landlord may terminate on ≥30 days' notice.

leaseAbstracts.narrative: Jersey Mike's (1,812 SF, expiry 11/30/2031, 2×5-yr options). No exclusive/co-tenancy; landlord go-dark recapture on a 120-day vacancy; Century Restaurants guaranty. Sales $710 PSF.

exclusives.description: While Tenant is open and operating as a T-Mobile retail location and not in default, an exclusive on wireless/telecom retail applies; leases executed after this is fully executed must honor Tenant's exclusive.

goDarkRight.summary: Must open ≥1 day within 270 days of Rent Commencement; thereafter no continuous-operation requirement (landlord remedy if it ceases — see kickout).

leaseNotes.label: Go Dark Option

leaseAbstracts.narrative: T-Mobile (T-Mobile Northeast LLC, suite 13A, 2×5-yr options). Wireless exclusive; a mid-term tenant termination right at the 84th month (pays unamortized brokerage); no continuous-operation covenant after opening.

exclusives.description: While open and operating without default, a wireless/telecom exclusive applies.

flags.detail: Verizon (6,500 SF — the larger of the two cell tenants) holds a ONE-TIME right to terminate effective 9/30/2026. Near-term income/vacancy risk on a sizeable pad — confirm whether Verizon has exercised/will exercise. (NOTE: the April-2026 rent roll text mislabeled Verizon's SF; the executed abstract confirms 6,500 SF / $110,500 / expiry 9/30/2028.)
